Will test a bit later.

FIY: When hostname unresolved OIO throws `java.net.UnknownHostException`, but NIO `java.nio.channels.UnresolvedAddressException`. So if epoll transport tries to be compatible replacement for NIO it's probably better to throw second (`UnresolvedAddressException`).
